checkpoints.notes: 5 concepts brainstormed and scored; Orbit Duel selected, Gravity Flip Runner as fallback.
Single-file HTML5 canvas architecture, tunable constants, testing plan defined.
Self-contained playable prototype: 2-player local gravity-duel arcade game, no build step, no external assets/deps.

Automated Playwright/headless-Chromium smoke tests: load+interaction test and ~6s extended-session test, both PASS. Found and fixed one test-hook staleness bug (window.__orbitDuel.bullets snapshot vs live getter) during testing. Win-condition end-to-end and fun/balance tuning are NOT covered by automated tests -- flagged as follow-up.

followUps: Human/manual playtest of Orbit Duel for feel/balance tuning (SHIP_THRUST, SHIP_DRAG, G, BULLET_SPEED).
Automated end-to-end test of the win condition + restart flow.
Consider a simple AI opponent or additional modes if this concept is revisited in a future cycle.
budgetNotes: Single-session run, no subagent fan-out used to conserve budget. Implementation kept to one self-contained HTML file (no build step) to keep scope tight. Cycle 1 completed fully within budget with no usage-limit warning encountered.
resumeInstructions: Cycle 1 is complete (phase: done) with valid outputs at every checkpoint -- do not re-execute cycle 1's research/design/implementation/testing phases. On next invocation, start Cycle 2 at 'research': read docs/concepts.md for prior art (avoid re-proposing Orbit Duel/Gravity Flip Runner/Color Bind/Signal Weaver/Chrono Loop verbatim; a genuine evolution of one is fine) and consider addressing the 'followUps' list above (e.g. iterating on Orbit Duel) as one of the new cycle's candidate concepts.
